items.title: 13.8 Aabi silver ion aur phir aabi ammonia ke saath halides ke reactions (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu introduction to topic 13.8, printed page 297.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Kitab is heading ke foran baad 13.8.1 shuru karti hai. Is hisse mein halide ions (F⁻, Cl⁻, Br⁻, I⁻) ko pehchanne ka do qadam wala test hai: pehle solution mein aqueous silver nitrate (AgNO₃) dala jata hai aur precipitate (neeche baithne wala thos) ka rang dekha jata hai (13.8.1); phir aqueous ammonia dal kar dekha jata hai ke precipitate hal hota hai ya nahi (13.8.2).

blocks.prompt: Aqueous potassium bromide (KBr) aur potassium iodide (KI) ko ek saada chemical test se kaise pehchanenge?
blocks.explanation: Dono mein aqueous silver nitrate dalein: KBr se cream rang ka AgBr precipitate aur KI se halka peela AgI precipitate banega. Phir concentrated ammonia dalein: cream AgBr hal ho kar be-rang solution deta hai, jab ke peela AgI hal nahi hota.

items: Silver nitrate test: Ag⁺ se AgCl (safed), AgBr (cream), AgI (peela) precipitate; F⁻ se koi precipitate nahi.
Phir ammonia: AgCl dilute mein, AgBr concentrated mein hal hota hai; AgI kisi mein nahi.
